production_ar_verdict: NOT ASSESSED BY APP: artistic competitiveness requires qualified human listening and current market context
limitations: The v0.9 controller is track-trained analytical ML, not a pretrained neural waveform model.
Tonal corridors are broad safety priors; autonomous selection is an engineering inference rather than human artistic approval.
Stereo Event Repair, Low-End Intelligence and Stereo Vocal Focus are bounded inferences from the authoritative stereo mix; each requires a separate measured promotion gate.

Section-Aware Mastering, AI-Generation Artifact Repair and Transient Intelligence are additional bounded authoritative-stereo candidates; artifact labels describe signal signatures and do not classify source provenance.
Tier 2 stems are alignment-checked analytical control evidence only; no separated-stem waveform or processed stem delta enters that candidate.
Preference Memory and Album Consistency can rank only candidates that already passed hard technical safety gates.
Click/dropout repair is limited to sample-proven isolated impulses and short exact-zero holes; ambiguous discontinuities remain review-only.
Device translation remains response simulation unless a human performs physical playback checks.
